crypto_keylength_justification: The runtime manages no encryption or signing keys. Case and producer IDs provide uniqueness, not authentication or bearer authority; their bit length is not a security key length: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/secure-development.md#cryptography-and-transport
crypto_working_justification: Runtime security-related randomness uses crypto/rand, with no dependency on MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4 or other broken/weak cryptographic primitives. math/rand serves execution choices and tests, not security: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/secure-development.md#cryptography-and-transport
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Runtime security-related randomness uses crypto/rand, with no dependency on MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4 or other broken/weak cryptographic primitives. math/rand serves execution choices and tests, not security: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/secure-development.md#cryptography-and-transport
crypto_pfs_justification: The runtime has no cryptographic key-agreement or encrypted-session implementation. The local development Kafka transport is plaintext and explicitly restricted to a trusted loopback deployment: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/secure-development.md#cryptography-and-transport
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project does not authenticate external users or store password credentials/hashes: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/secure-development.md#cryptography-and-transport
crypto_random_justification: Case and transactional-producer identifiers use Go crypto/rand, never math/rand. No cryptographic keys or authentication nonces are otherwise generated by the runtime: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/docket/docket.go and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/docket/kafka.go

static_analysis_justification: make verify runs FLOSS go vet and golangci-lint/staticcheck. The release workflow must pass make verify and govulncheck before publishing; CodeQL also runs on main and PRs: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/Makefile and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: govulncheck checks reachable vulnerable dependencies, while CodeQL analyzes Go security patterns and golangci-lint runs govet, staticcheck, errcheck and other defect analyzers: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/.golangci.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: The identified CodeQL integer-narrowing alert was addressed by retaining int64 proceedings-cache indexes and validating window bounds, with boundary regression tests. The security policy requires timely fixes for confirmed exploitable findings: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/docket/kafka.go and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/docket/kafka_regression_test.go and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/SECURITY.md
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every push to main and pull request; release verification repeats it for the release revision: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: make verify runs the Go race detector plus timed parser/compiler and LSP-framing fuzz tests. CI runs these on main and PRs; the release workflow runs make verify before publishing: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/Makefile and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/testing.md
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project produces Go code, has no C/C++ source or cgo boundary, and builds with CGO_ENABLED=0. The race detector and Go fuzzing run regardless: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/Makefile and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/go.mod
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Go unit/property tests and fuzz targets assert parser rejection, frame bounds, atomicity, ownership and replay behavior; these test assertions are not in production binaries: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/gregor/fuzz_test.go and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/internal/counsel/framing_regression_test.go and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/testing.md
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Race and parser/framing fuzz checks pass; no confirmed exploitable dynamic-analysis vulnerability remains identified in this assessment. Any future medium-or-higher finding follows the explicit security remediation deadlines: https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/SECURITY.md and https://github.com/lennrt/trial-lang/blob/main/docs/testing.md
